title: Record event (v2)
description: SoT §43.6 and PERD §32.1, §32.2. The Record is append-only and hash-chained per tenant (INV-11). v2 carries the PERD §32.1 additions to the SoT §43.6 fields: schema_version (major 2), tenant_id, seq, payload_hash and actor, and its first event has the tenant-scoped genesis hash instead of 64 zeros. It adds six grant-void reasons (nine in all). record-event.v1.json is unchanged and stays valid for v1 documents; a v2 event is not a v1 event and the reverse. Hash correctness and the genesis rule are checked by the chain verification, not by the schema. The model said so is never provenance: object_ref names an object, not a free-text claim.

RecordEventType.description: PERD §32.2 (53 types) plus four types that PERD requirements already use and that DEC-2026-10-18 adds to the table (PERD v1.9, Noemai-org/docs#14): AUDIO_RETAINED (REQ-VOI-004), INBOUND_EVENT_RECEIVED (REQ-API-008), RESOLUTION_POSTED (REQ-API-007), CONFIG_CHANGED (REQ-OPS-003). Not Record events, so not in this list: INTENT_SUPERSEDED (REQ-INT-004) and STATE_CHANGED (REQ-RES-004) are reasons carried by GRANT_VOIDED, and RECORD_ACCESSED (REQ-AUD-003) is written to the access log, not the chain.

GrantVoidReason.description: Why a grant was voided; carried by GRANT_VOIDED only. Nine distinct values, one per reason PERD §27.1 and REQ-EXE-003 name for a void grant; an unknown value is rejected. None of them is a Record event type. v1 listed the first three; v2 adds SIGNATURE_INVALID, EXPIRED, BINDING_MISMATCH, WRITES_DISABLED, REVALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE and REJECTED_STALE_VERSION (DEC-2026-10-27-record-event-v2). Meanings: INTENT_SUPERSEDED: E3 (PERD §27.1): the grant's intent hash is no longer the latest admitted intent's hash. PERD REQ-INT-004. STATE_CHANGED: E7 (PERD §27.1, REQ-EXE-003): revalidation re-read a fact and it differs from the evidence set, the ownership or the freeze. PERD REQ-RES-004. POLICY_SUPERSEDED: E4 (PERD §27.1): the decision's policy version is no longer ACTIVE. PERD REQ-TRU-005, US-08. SIGNATURE_INVALID: E1 (PERD §27.1): the grant's HMAC does not verify under any active key ID, or the key ID is unknown. EXPIRED: E2 (PERD §27.1): not_before <= now < expires_at does not hold by the clock source. BINDING_MISMATCH: E5 (PERD §27.1): plan_hash or plan_step does not match the stored plan, the capability is unregistered, prohibited or has no adapter, or params_hash is not the hash of the parameters. Also: the grant is malformed, or it names another tenant. WRITES_DISABLED: E6 (PERD §27.1, REQ-EXE-008): the tenant kill switch is on or the circuit is open, read at E6 or again inside the spend transaction. REVALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE: E7 (PERD §27.1, REQ-EXE-003): a revalidation read could not be made. The grant is void; Trust decides next. REJECTED_STALE_VERSION: The target refused the expected version token (PERD REQ-EXE-004). The grant is void and the write is not retried without a new grant.

ProviderFailoverReason.description: Why the Intent Compiler failed over to the next provider; carried by PROVIDER_FAILOVER only (PERD v1.12 REQ-INT-002, DEC-2026-10-21-int-002-refusal-failover). PROVIDER_ERROR: the provider returned an error. TIMEOUT: it did not answer in time. REFUSED_REPLY: it replied in the wrong format, failing the schema check of REQ-INT-001; it does not mean the provider declined to answer. The values are a default for the Founders to confirm.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this event: major 2. v1 events carry major 1 and are not valid here.

seq.description: Monotonic position in the tenant's chain, starting at 1 (PERD §32.1).

prev_hash.description: The hash of the previous event of the tenant's chain. For seq 1 it is the tenant's genesis hash: sha256: followed by the hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of "noema:genesis:" followed by tenant_id (PERD §32.1). 64 zeros is the v1 genesis value and is not valid in v2.

hash.description: sha256: followed by the hex SHA-256 of prev_hash (its sha256:-prefixed text, as UTF-8) followed by the JCS (RFC 8785) of this event without hash (PERD §32.1). Checked by the chain verifier, not by the schema.

actor.description: The power or service identity, plus the principal where relevant (PERD §32.1): the power in upper case, optionally followed by a colon and the principal ID. The separator is the smallest form that keeps the two parts apart; it is a default for the founders to confirm.

payload_hash.description: The hash of the referenced object's canonical JSON (PERD §32.1). An event that refers to no object carries the hash of the empty object {}: sha256:44136fa355b3678a1146ad16f7e8649e94fb4fc21fe77e8310c060f61caaff8a.

reason.description: GRANT_VOIDED carries a GrantVoidReason; PROVIDER_FAILOVER carries a ProviderFailoverReason. No other event carries one.
